definitions.pressure: T20 second-innings pre-ball state with 1-30 balls remaining, at least 3 wickets down, required rate >= 15, and positive runs needed.
definitions.bowling_pressure: T20 second-innings pre-ball state with 1-30 balls remaining, 2 or fewer wickets down, current rate >= 11, required rate >= 9, and positive runs needed.
definitions.target: matches.revised_target when present; otherwise the first-innings sum of runs plus one each for wide, Overstep/no-ball, bye, and leg-bye rows, then +1.
definitions.raw_team_runs_proxy: runs plus one per wide, Overstep/no-ball, bye, and leg-bye row. Byes and leg-byes are imputed as one run per row because this export records no run amount for those types. extras_2_runs is not used by this specified formula.
definitions.bowler_runs_proxy: runs plus one per wide or Overstep/no-ball row; byes and leg-byes are not charged. extras_2_runs is not used by this specified formula.
definitions.legal_ball_map: None/byes/legbyes are known legal; wide/Overstep are known illegal; other/Penalty/blank/unmapped values have unknown legality.
definitions.unknown_state: Unknown-legality events are excluded from ball counts; the event row and all later chase states in that innings are marked unknown.
definitions.regular_innings_scope: Player, venue, and chase analytics use innings 1 and 2. Extra innings are retained in deliveries and excluded from standard T20 views.
definitions.balls_faced: Delivery rows excluding wides and rows with unknown legality; Overstep/no-ball events count as faced.
definitions.sample_adjustments: Composite-score shrinkage uses 60 prior balls for batting strike rate, 3 prior dismissals for batting average, and 60 prior legal balls for bowling economy and wicket rate. Raw figures remain displayed alongside adjusted figures.
